items.title: Should You Brace For A Fall In American Airlines Stock?
items.summary: American Airlines (AAL) trades at about $12.97, roughly 29% below its 52-week high after falling about 21.8% over the past month. Over the trailing twelve months it returned -3.5% while the S&P 500 returned 21.1%. In July it reported record quarterly revenue. A record quarter and a cut outlook sit together for a reason, and that reason is also why its falls run deeper than the market's.

items.title: 1 Large-Cap Stock with Impressive Fundamentals and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Large-cap stocks have the power to shape entire industries thanks to their size and widespread influence. With such vast footprints, however, finding new areas for growth is much harder than for smaller, more agile players.

items.title: AIG’s Zaffino Stepping Down as Chairman, Joining Palantir
items.summary: Peter Zaffino, who earlier this year retired as AIG’s chief executive, will join Palantir as global head of financial services.

items.title: 2 S&P 500 Stocks with Competitive Advantages and 1 That Underwhelm
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.

items.title: This is Why  American International Group (AIG) is a Great Dividend Stock
items.summary: Dividends are one of the best benefits to being a shareholder, but finding a great dividend stock is no easy task. Does American International Group (AIG) have what it takes? Let's find out.

items.title: 1 Value Stock with Impressive Fundamentals and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Value stocks typically trade at discounts to the broader market, offering patient investors the opportunity to buy businesses when they’re out of favor. The key risk, however, is that these stocks are usually cheap for a reason, and a low valuation can reflect underlying business challenges rather than a genuine bargain.

items.title: The Fall and Redemption of Bill Miller, the Greatest Money Manager of Our Time
items.summary: He was known as one of the world’s best investors, until he got smacked down by the financial crisis. But almost 20 years later, his ideas and legacy resonate strongly.
